description: Verifies web UI behavior in a real browser using the strongest browser/DevTools/Playwright capability actually available on the current host. Use after frontend changes or for browser-only bugs. Checks interaction, console, network, responsive behavior, screenshots, recordings, accessibility signals, and performance evidence rather than treating a successful build as proof.
